algorithm_contract.candidate_pair_rule: Score only a selection-locked variant-gene or locus-gene candidate table created without held outcomes. Candidate generation is not part of the distance scorer.
algorithm_contract.gene_identity: GENCODE v49 Ensembl gene_id with version; an unversioned Ensembl ID is accepted only through a frozen one-to-one version-stripping crosswalk. Gene symbols never define identity.
algorithm_contract.locus_gene_score: negative minimum TSS distance across the selection-locked variants assigned to that locus
algorithm_contract.pair_score: negative integer distance in bp between the normalized variant anchor and the closest annotated transcript TSS for the candidate gene; larger is better
algorithm_contract.ties: Emit equal scores for equal distances. Do not use gene symbols, held labels, or random jitter to break ties.
algorithm_contract.transcript_policy: Use every GENCODE v49 transcript row retained on analysis contigs and take the minimum distance for its gene. Do not choose a canonical transcript from outcomes or expression.
algorithm_contract.tss_coordinate: Convert GTF 1-based closed transcript coordinates to zero-based anchors: start-1 on '+' and end-1 on '-'.
algorithm_contract.variant_anchor: After left normalization and REF validation, use VCF POS-1, the zero-based anchor of the leftmost REF base. Structural or unresolved variants are ineligible.

input_contract.candidate_rows: Canonical variant_id, gene_id, native_build, GRCh38.p14 coordinate or frozen unique one-to-one liftover, LD block, locus, and row hash
input_contract.excluded_annotation: patch, haplotype, alternate, scaffold, and non-analysis contig genes are not silently projected to primary contigs
input_contract.liftover: For non-GRCh38 native inputs, retain native coordinates and LD grouping, require a frozen unique one-to-one GRCh38.p14 mapping and REF match, then compute distance. Failed or ambiguous mappings are untestable, not distant.
input_contract.runtime_lookups: No Ensembl, UCSC, NCBI, HGNC, expression, disease, eQTL, or internet lookup at inference.

output_contract.allele_effect: none; REF and ALT at one anchor receive the same proximity score
output_contract.native_output: unsigned TSS-proximity enhancer_gene_link_score plus distance_bp and selected TSS/gene identifiers
output_contract.ranking: closer TSS ranks first within the exact frozen candidate denominator

inductive_and_held_source_contract.held_source_behavior: Compute distance from anonymized selection-locked coordinates and gene IDs without held outcomes. The method has no source-specific parameter.
inductive_and_held_source_contract.inductive_behavior: Scores any valid new variant-gene pair represented in the frozen annotation and coordinate contract.
inductive_and_held_source_contract.source_removal: A graph held source may not select locus anchors, variants, genes, candidate radius, transcripts, or ties. Source-specific observability and outcomes remain evaluator-only.
inductive_and_held_source_contract.warning: If the held source defines which gene pairs exist, scoring only those pairs leaks its assay coverage. Candidate rows must be source-independent or supplied as anonymized evaluator features under a precommitted roster.

runtime_and_artifact_contract.tss_artifact_receipt: Record source GTF hash, accepted feature types and contigs, gene/transcript parsing counts, duplicate IDs, coordinate examples on both strands, version crosswalk, sorted rows, size, and SHA-256.
runtime_and_artifact_contract.output_receipt: Hash algorithm ID, TSS artifact, candidate table, coordinate and liftover receipts, distances, ties, row order, and PredictionBundle.

safe_loading_contract.serialized_inputs: schema-validated plain text or columnar project artifacts only

source_evidence: The project reference, coordinate, variant capability, graph, and locus split contracts plus official GENCODE release history, data-access, and GTF-format pages were inspected on 2026-08-22. No upstream software, alternate annotation, model, or weights were downloaded or run.

terms_audit.annotation_access: GENCODE states its project data are open access
terms_audit.redistribution: Release the derived TSS and prediction artifacts only after preserving GENCODE attribution and reviewing project source and evaluator-row terms.
